definitions.explanation: A mental picture or general impression one has of something or someone.
The way a person, company, or product is perceived by others.

examples.japanese: どんなイメージですか。
examples.english: What kind of impression is it?

examples.japanese: イメージ{通|どお}りの{人|ひと}だった。
examples.english: They were just as I had imagined.
examples.notes: イメージ{通|どお}り = just as imagined

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}に{対|たい}するイメージが{変|か}わった。
この{曲|きょく}を{聞|き}くと{夏|なつ}のイメージが{湧|わ}く。
examples.english: When I hear this song, images of summer come to mind.
examples.notes: イメージが{湧|わ}く = to be able to picture something

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}を{読|よ}んでも、{完成|かんせい}した{姿|すがた}のイメージがなかなか{湧|わ}かなかった。
examples.english: Even after reading the explanation, I couldn't quite picture what it would look like when finished.

examples.japanese: イメージが{良|よ}い{商品|しょうひん}だ。
examples.english: It's a product with a good image.

examples.japanese: あの{俳優|はいゆう}はイメージがとても{良|よ}い。
examples.english: That actor has a very good public image.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}のイメージアップのために{広告|こうこく}キャンペーンを{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: We ran an advertising campaign to improve the company's image.
examples.notes: イメージアップ = improving one's image

examples.japanese: {不祥事|ふしょうじ}でブランドのイメージが{大|おお}きく{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: The brand's image took a big hit because of the scandal.

examples.japanese: {髪型|かみがた}を{変|か}えてイメージチェンジをしたいと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: I'm thinking of changing my hairstyle for a new look.
examples.notes: イメージチェンジ = image change, makeover

notes:
USAGE: イメージ is used broadly for mental images, impressions, and public perception. It's more abstract than {写真|しゃしん} (photograph).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・イメージが{良|よ}い/{悪|わる}い (have a good/bad image)
・イメージを{持|も}つ (to have an impression)
・イメージ{通|どお}り (as imagined)
・イメージが{湧|わ}く (to be able to picture something)
・イメージチェンジ (image change, makeover)
・イメージアップ/ダウン (image improvement/damage)

[Register: Neutral]
